title: Russian Casserole with Intensely Fermented Flavor
description: A French-inspired casserole dish featuring a blend of intensely fermented ingredients and classic Russian flavors.
instructions: Cook Russian sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
In a separate pot, combine sauerkraut and enough water to cover it. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, butter, milk, egg, salt, and pepper.
Add cooked sausage and sauerkraut to the mixing bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until casserole is golden brown and set.
Garnish with chopped fresh dill, if desired.
